review.assessment: The change replaces the fragile JSON.stringify comparison with a manual recursive structural checker that explicitly handles NaN, distinguishes null from undefined, and ignores object key ordering by verifying property lengths and existence. However, it introduces a scope-leak typo in the object iteration loop where the array index variable i is referenced instead of the correct key variable key, causing an immediate crash on any object comparison.

findings.defect: Typo in object comparison loop accesses out-of-scope variable i
